atomic_claims.finding: FlushFileBuffers and CloseHandle require explicit HANDLE signatures and return types before directory durability is established.
Streaming bytes directly into the final O_EXCL pathname can expose a permanently partial authorization record.
Write and fsync a deterministic pending object before atomic no-replace hard-link publication of the final pathname.
Orphan pending, mismatched links, collision, short write, or ambiguous durability state is terminal ADVERSE and never resumable.

required_controls: Explicit Win64 ctypes signatures for every invoked kernel API.
O_EXCL binary pending creation, complete bounded write, file fsync, and successful close before publication.
Atomic no-replace hard-link publication; never rename-over, truncate, delete, recycle, or compensate.
Retain pending evidence and verify pending/final identity and canonical bytes.
No activation, remote mutation, or release integration surface.
